UPDATE downloads
            SET status = CASE status
                    WHEN 'pending' THEN 'resolving'
                    WHEN 'downloaded' THEN 'tagging'
                END,
                version = version + 1,
                next_retry_at = NULL,
                finished_at = NULL,
                error_message = NULL,
                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE id = (
                SELECT id FROM downloads
                WHERE status IN ('pending', 'downloaded')
                  AND id NOT IN (
                      SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
                      FROM json_each(?)
                  )
                  AND (
                      next_retry_at IS NULL
                      OR julianday(next_retry_at) <= julianday('now')
                  )
                ORDER BY
                    CASE status
                        WHEN 'downloaded' THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,
                    COALESCE(next_retry_at, created_at),
                    created_at,
                    id
                LIMIT 1
            )
            RETURNING
                id,
                provider,
                track_id,
                quality,
                metadata AS "metadata!: Metadata",
                status AS "status!: DownloadStatus",
                downloaded_bytes,
                total_bytes,
                version,
                retry_count,
                path,
                error_message
